extracted.name: Emergency Garlic Bread
extracted.description: This garlic bread recipe uses sliced hot dog buns brushed with butter and sprinkled with garlic powder for a quick and easy side with 3 ingredients.
ingredient_lines: 4 teaspoons butter, softened, or as needed
2 teaspoons garlic powder, or to taste
instruction_lines: Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.
Separate buns and spread butter onto the cut side of each one.
Sprinkle with garlic powder. Place on a baking tray.
Toast under the preheated broiler until golden brown, about 4 minutes.
